name: Bless Me, Dark Maiden
source:
You failed your mission. Now you're a captive, waiting for the worst punishment.

But the bed is too soft and food is always fresh and delicious. Your captors keep smiling—no whips, no chains, no daggers in the dark.

Two handsome men hover nearby—one calm and watchful, the other sharp and mocking. They offer you kindness like it's nothing. You don't trust them, but... Are you really a captive?

[From [url=https://dillayaart.itch.io/bless-me-dark-maiden]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的使命失败了。现在你是一名俘虏，等待着最严厉的惩罚。

但床太软了，食物总是新鲜可口。抓捕你的人一直微笑着——没有鞭子，没有锁链，没有黑暗中的匕首。

两个英俊的男人在附近徘徊——一个冷静而警惕，另一个尖锐而嘲讽。他们为你提供善意，就像什么都没有一样。你不信任他们，但是……你真的是俘虏吗？

[来自[url=https://dillayaart.itch.io/bless-me-dark-maiden]itch.io[/url]]
